claim: The InferencePool resource graduated to v1 GA as of GIE release v1.0.0.
stance_target: current stability/version status of the InferencePool API
quoted_support: GA since v1.0.0. The InferencePool resource has been graduated to v1 and is considered stable.

claim: InferencePool's selector field selects Pods by exact label match; the resource is defined as a group of Pods dedicated to serving AI models.
stance_target: InferencePool's selector semantics are Pod-only (label selector over Pods, no other backend kind supported)
quoted_support: The `selector` field specifies which Pods belong to this pool. The labels in this selector must exactly match the labels applied to your model server Pods.

claim: InferencePool's targetPorts field defines the port numbers the Inference Gateway routes to on selected model server Pods.
quoted_support: The `targetPorts` field defines the port numbers that the Inference Gateway should route to on model server Pods that belong to this pool.

claim: As of release v1.5.0, the InferencePool field endpointPickerRef became optional (previously required), allowing InferencePool usage without a user-managed Endpoint Picker deployment.
stance_target: the EPP/router component is becoming a pluggable, optional layer rather than a mandatory fixed dependency
scope_conditions: GIE release history, as of v1.5.0 and later
quoted_support: Until release `v1.5.0`, the InferencePool field `endpointPickerRef` was required. Currently, it is optional, to allow usages of InferencePool without user-managed Endpoint Picker deployments.

claim: InferencePool's endpointPickerRef.failureMode field (e.g. FailOpen) controls gateway behavior when the EPP fails or is unresponsive: FailOpen forwards the request to a gateway-chosen endpoint instead of failing the request.
quoted_support: With `failureMode: FailOpen`, if EPP fails to pick an endpoint or is not responsive, the request is forwarded to an endpoint chosen by the gateway.

claim: Any Pod joining an InferencePool must support the Model Server Protocol so the EPP has adequate information to route requests intelligently.
stance_target: the Model Server Protocol is the exact contract a non-pod backend must satisfy to integrate with GIE's EPP
quoted_support: Additionally, any Pod that seeks to join an InferencePool would need to support the model server protocol, defined by this project, to ensure the Endpoint Picker has adequate information to intelligently route requests.
